div.head: IV Eg 4
div.ab: To ælcere byrig XXXVI syn gecorone to gewitnesse;
To ælcere byrig XXXIII syn gecorene to gewytnesse;
Et ad hoc procurandum et tutandum uiri triginta sex legitimi,
To ælcere byrig XXXVI syn gecorene to gewytnesse.
zu jeder Stadt seien 36 als Zeugenschaft erkoren,
for every borough let 36 be chosen as witnesses,
36 persons shall be chosen as witnesses for every borough.
Thirty-six are to be chosen as witness for each borough;
div.note: C's ‘XXXIII’ is a misreading of ‘XXXVI’ (the u = V looks similar in F too).; BF: added from Gesetze I p. 210, October 2026 (MS C (Latin)); O: corrected against Gesetze I, October 2026 (was “(Latin version of C)”, now “∅ (moved to BF)”)

note.seg: so, II verlesen statt·u (d. i. V), welches auch in F ähnlich wie ıı aussieht
thus; II misread for ·u (i.e. V), which in F too looks similar to ıı
Diese von Schmid trotz C's Fehler vermutete Zahl 36 bestätigt F und Versio 10 nochmals
This number 36, conjectured by Schmid despite C's error, is confirmed once more by F and Versio 10
Wohl aus den Bürgern, durch Obrigkeit (Richter), vielleicht in Gemeinschaft mit der Gerichtsgemeinde
Probably from among the burgesses, by the authorities (judge), perhaps jointly with the community of the court
There is little doubt that the reading xxxvi in F and the Latin version is correct. III and VI are often confused in MSS.
